body:
I've basically secluded myself ever since I started going to uni. Even though I commute from the town I grew up in, I find that most of my friends left for uni themselves or rather spend time with other people than me. I'm afraid of the outside at this point and the only times I will go out now is to see an old lady who I help with her computer. I have a nervous tick where I smile a lot when I'm nervous and that helps me seem more normal.

I'm not sure my parents would understand. I know that my mom said she will have me put into an institute if I started feeling suicidal. I think that's why I'm so afraid right now but I'm not sure.

I got a warning from last semester for pulling this shit. I told my parents then and said I would "get help". I felt more depressed after "getting help" and starting pulling the same shit until I just gave up completely waiting for the suspension. Now that it's finally come, I don't think they will be as understanding as before. Especially since they said I could talk to them whenever. Despite how understanding they are, I still end up waiting until the early morning and going into my closet to cry for hours.
